name: AMR Grid Completion
aliases: Adaptive Wavelet Grid to AMR Conversion
Completing Wavelet Based Grid to AMR
definition: A preprocessing technique that converts an adaptive wavelet grid into a traditional node-centered Adaptive Mesh Refinement (AMR) grid by adding supplementary nodes, allowing the use of existing AMR visualization software.
summary: AMR Grid Completion converts adaptive wavelet grids into node-centered AMR grids, enabling compatibility with established visualization software like ParaView and VisIt.
